reason: Adds a new custom JsonConverter for ElasticsearchIndexMetadata and changes index map serialization to round-trip through JsonDocument, which touches persisted recipe/index-profile document shape and could subtly alter serialization/deserialization behavior for existing Elasticsearch index profiles across tenants if not thoroughly tested.
